text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Mooommy~♡ The birthday presents were 
amazing~♡♡ The topaz ring too~♡ And the 
diamond watch from Daddy~♡

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
(I haven't prepared anything that fancy, 
you know!?\nMy present to you is—)

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
—Hey! Kawakami-senpai! Got business with 
me? Do ya? Wait, is that what I think it 
is in your hands~??

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh?! Ah, Happy Birthday! I even had a 
present ready for you, but—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Not anything extravagant like jewelry... 
Just a completely ordinary... Pre-Fi nail 
polish set.

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text: Wait, isn't this way too good~~!?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really? A serious gift like this!? 
I'm so ridiculously happy right now!

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Like, how could I NOT be happy about 
this~!? I mean, Senpai is giving me 
Pre-Fi, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
I can really feel the love~♡ It feels like 
you're sharing all your passion for your 
favorite things with me too...♪

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Also, also! I've been meaning to chat with 
you about this! Back in the day, I was a 
suuuper huge fan of PreFie â¡

text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
Which warrior did you like best, Senpai? I 
liked the blonde one~... ...Wait, Senpai, 
are you listening~?
